column2: Yes... For the sake of the people who suffered, I must...{wait}{clear}And I will restore the Empire's honor, too. I promise.
Knighthood
Why did you become a knight?

Why is a hard question to answer...{wait}{clear}I suppose it's because I watched my father ever since I was little. I wanted to fight at his side...{wait}{clear}Besides, I always liked swords better than dolls and dresses...
I wonder where your strength comes from, Leyla.
My strength? I've never even thought about it.{wait}{clear}Let me see... Maybe it's because I want to catch up with my father, even knowing I never can...{wait}{clear}I really don't know.
Living as a knight...
I know what you're trying to say...{wait}{clear}But let's not talk about this...
Angel, is there something else you wanted to talk about?
Yes, I'm fine.{wait}{clear}I'm so happy to be able to walk through all these lands. So a little tiredness doesn't bother me.{wait}{clear}But I really shouldn't be feeling this carefree, should I...
Yes!{wait}{clear}But walking side by side with an angel feels a little strange, doesn't it?
Yes, I really think so too.{wait}{clear}But when the strong winds blow now and then, I get an uneasy feeling...{wait}{clear}I hope it's just my imagination...
Yes, please don't worry, Angel. Rough ground and forests are actually easier for me to walk through.{wait}{clear}Living in the forest, I got used to walking where there are no paths.

Yes... it happens...{wait}{clear}I try to keep an eye on landmarks, just like when I walk through the forest...{wait}{clear}But when I get caught up in something new, or go somewhere crowded, I lose track of where I am...{wait}{clear}That never happened to me in the forest.

So you think so too, Angel. I also find the sky very beautiful.{wait}{clear}Sometimes it shows an angry face, with storms and harsh droughts...{wait}{clear}But it gives us plenty of light and rain. To me it's a beautiful, precious sky.
Yes, I think so too.{wait}{clear}Right now I feel that way about everything I see...{wait}{clear}Things made by nature, of course, but things made by human hands as well...
Yes, of course.{wait}{clear}With that little body, they work so very hard for me.{wait}{clear}I wish I could do something for them in return... Do you have any good ideas, Angel?

Let me see...{wait}{clear}I always wanted to leave the forest, but I never dreamed I'd end up traveling with an angel...{wait}{clear}At first everything I saw was so unusual, and it all seemed so fascinating.{wait}{clear}It still does... but... I feel I've come to understand all over again how precious the forest is.

Yes.{wait}{clear}Meeting all kinds of people, talking with them... it makes me feel so many things.{wait}{clear}Some of the townspeople seem a little cold... but now I think their hearts aren't so different from everyone's in the forest.
Thank you, Angel. I hope I'll sleep soundly and have nice dreams.
Yes, Angel, thank you for today. Aren't you tired too, Angel?{wait}{clear}You're always worrying about me... Please make sure you rest properly too, Angel.

You ask the strangest things sometimes, Angel.{wait}{clear}I don't dislike sleeping. A lazy nap up in a forest tree, or on the grass in a little clearing, feels wonderful.{wait}{clear}I wish you could try it once too, Angel.

So much really happens every day, doesn't it? Happy things, and things that aren't...{wait}{clear}Before bed I often end up thinking over everything that happened that day...{wait}{clear}But please don't worry, Angel. I'll get my sleep.
I offer a prayer of thanks to the forest and to nature, which support everything we are.{wait}{clear}I'll never forget that, wherever I go.
Yes, I've gotten quite used to it. But sometimes I fondly remember the feel of my simple bed in the forest.

When I really can't sleep, I go outside. If it's clear I look at the stars, and if there's a forest or a grove nearby, I go there.{wait}{clear}Watching the stars twinkle and bathing in their light, or hearing the trees whisper in the forest, calms my heart.

Yes... I've never forgotten it.{wait}{clear}It's because of the way things are that I keep thinking about the forest.{wait}{clear}There are truly so many things I only understood once I came out into the world.{wait}{clear}Thank you for guiding me, Angel...
Yes, gladly. What shall we talk about, Angel?

What a strange thing to wonder about, Angel.{wait}{clear}Let me see... Since I started traveling I've been on my own, so I don't do anything special...{wait}{clear}In the forest I'd go fetch water, make breakfast... all sorts of things. Now I'm taking it very easy.
Yes, of course. I've only just begun.{wait}{clear}Besides, I'm still far from strong enough as I am now...
Thanks? Please don't worry about that, Angel.{wait}{clear}I'm proud to serve you, and I'm only doing what I should.{wait}{clear}I'll do my best, so please keep watching over me.

Well... I'd be lying if I said it wasn't hard. But it's something I have to do.{wait}{clear}If I slack off now, things will only get worse, and I'll cause you trouble too, Angel.{wait}{clear}But I won't push myself too hard, so please don't worry.
Thank you for your concern. But I'm fine, so please don't worry.{wait}{clear}When I'm tired, I'll rest properly. Training too hard doesn't do any good, after all.

That's true... But Angel, please don't misunderstand.{wait}{clear}I don't practice only for fighting.{wait}{clear}It's for hunting, or picking nuts from high branches... A bow isn't a tool for hurting people...
You worry about the strangest things, Angel.{wait}{clear}I'm confident in my stamina. When you hunt in the forest, you can't do anything without it.
You're such a worrier, Angel. But I'm fine, so please rest easy.
Yes, I'm thinking about concentrating.{wait}{clear}I feel that unless I calm my heart first, nothing I do goes well.
How I'm doing? I think I'm doing well.{wait}{clear}After all, you're here with me, Angel. I'll do my best.
Yes. When I see results, it really encourages me.{wait}{clear}But I don't think it's right to seek results only by hurting people.
No, please don't worry about it. You're welcome to visit any time, Angel.{wait}{clear}Since you're here, shall we talk a while?
I like lots of things... In the forest I loved swimming in the rivers and lakes.{wait}{clear}In the water my body feels so light, and it's so refreshing...
Yes, it does.{wait}{clear}Lying in a meadow, gazing at the river, watching the stars at night...{wait}{clear}Spending slow, quiet time like that is such a nice change of pace, isn't it?

Let me see... In the forest, everything I did felt like play. Climbing trees, catching fish in the river, hunting...{wait}{clear}Hehe... come to think of it, what I do now isn't so different.{wait}{clear}But maybe that's what matters, that it hasn't changed...
Yes. I was just thinking the same thing.
Yes, I understand.{wait}{clear}I don't know how much I can do, but I always want to be of use to you, Angel.{wait}{clear}As long as you're by my side, I think I can keep trying my best.
Thank you, Angel. But if you keep worrying about others like that, you'll wear yourself out.{wait}{clear}I'll take my rest, so you should relax once in a while too, Angel.
Let me see... I'm thinking about all sorts of things...{wait}{clear}But I also feel like I might be thinking too much...{wait}{clear}I should keep it in moderation, shouldn't I?

I don't go there much... I've gotten used to big towns, but I don't seem to like crowded places.{wait}{clear}I feel much calmer out in nature than where there are lots of people...{wait}{clear}Oh, but if you have an errand for me, Angel, I'll go, so just say the word.

Yes, I'm eating properly. I've gotten quite used to town food.{wait}{clear}The same vegetables taste different when they're cooked differently, so I was surprised at first.{wait}{clear}When I go back to the forest, I want to make the dishes I liked for everyone.
I'm fine, Angel. Please rest easy.
